text:
mira: Quick FYI — I brought up sirocco-v2 int8 (q4f) on staging and ran our multilingual suite. Seeing a regression pattern around ZWJ/narrow glyph boundaries in JP/AR that looks quantization-related.

mira: Paste of the short summary: 
```
ja BLEU: 22.4 (-3.7 vs fp32)
zh BLEU: 29.1 (-0.5)
ar BLEU: 18.0 (-4.2 vs fp32)
AR bracket-mirror errors: ~8% of samples flagged
Failing tokenization cases often include ZWJ (U+200D) or narrow no-break space (U+202F) next to punctuation.
Example failing pair (input -> model output):
"お待ちください
" -> missing joiner in output, punctuation detached
"(مثال)" -> becomes ")مثال(" or loses RTL mirroring
```

kai: Can you repro locally or is this only in staging quant?

mira: Repro is consistent on staging int8 build (kernel set: auto). I ran a small local smoke with the same q4f artifact and reproduced.

devon: Tokenizer changed in onboarding patch? We switched tokenizer v2 mapping for ZWJ normalizations last week. Might be an interaction with quantized embedding indices.

ash: @devon good call. Any diffs in tokenizer->vocab ordering that could shift ids?

devon: Not reorder but we do now normalize U+202F -> NBSP in preproc for some locales. That could change prefix caching behavior.

ash: Also check KV-cache path: int8 path uses alternate KVC packing which had one-off indexing bug in earlier kernel.

mira: I ran a quick bisect: when I use fp32 weights + tokenizer v2 -> no regression. When int8 quantizer + tokenizer v1 -> smaller regression. Largest delta when int8 + tokenizer v2. So looks like a combined effect.

eva: Could you share 10 minimal repros (orig + model outputs)? I can add them to the eval harness and run paired stats.

mira: Dropping 6 examples here, will push full set to S3.

mira: Sample 1 (JP):
Input: "彼は茶碗
を持っている。"
Output int8: "彼は茶碗を 持っている。"  (extra space before verb, joiner dropped)

mira: Sample 2 (AR):
Input: "(تجربة)"
Output int8: ")تجربة("  (mirroring flipped)

kai: @eval-bot can you run the compare run: sirocco-v2 fp32 vs q4f-int8 on mira/jp/ar subsets and post token diffs?

eval-bot: CI triggered: compare-run/1765439999 — queued. Link: https://ci.redwood/sirocco/compare/1765439999

devon: For quick triage: try forcing kernel selection to "fp32-emulate" on int8 path (slower) to isolate packing vs numeric error. If error persists -> probably token id shuffle or tokenizer side.

mira: Will try that in next hour and post results. Also testing fallback with prefix-caching disabled (cache_affinity=off) to rule out KV-index mismatch.

ash: If this is combined tokenizer+quant issue, we should consider a short-term mitigations: 1) pin tokenizer v1 for int8 canary, 2) enable mirroring sanity check in eval alerts.

eva: Agreed. Add autometric that flags punctuation mirror flips and ZWJ detachment > 2% on canary.

mira: Action items:
- mira: run fp32-emulate kernel test + cache off (ETA 60m)
- devon: diff tokenizer normalizations and vocab id mapping (ETA EOD)
- eva: add the 10 repros to harness and add mirror/ZWJ alert (ETA tomorrow)

kai: Thanks Mira — keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

mira: posting S3 link for full repro set once upload completes.

eval-bot: compare-run finished: sirocco-v2 q4f-int8 vs fp32 — summary: JP BLEU delta -3.6, AR BLEU delta -4.1, flagged 124/150 ZWJ-related anomalies. Link: https://ci.redwood/sirocco/compare/1765439999/results

mira: got it. Will iterate on config and report back.

kai: If you need a quick rollback on staging, ping infra.

mira: will do if we can't find mitigation today.
